# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the OpenMP oracle tests.
#
# LLVM's libomp runtime is not TSan-instrumented, so its INTERNAL mutex pool
# (pthread_mutex_init in one worker vs pthread_mutex_lock in another, both frames
# inside libomp.so) trips the tool. This entry silences only accesses whose racy
# frames are inside libomp.so -- races in user code (both stacks instrumented)
# still report. OpenMP happens-before semantics (parallel-region barriers etc.)
# are made visible to TSan via the Archer OMPT tool (OMP_TOOL_LIBRARIES points at
# libarcher.so); without Archer, gcc/libgomp region-end barriers are invisible and
# every AppData destructor after a parallel kernel reports a bogus race.
called_from_lib:libomp.so
